guide.giver: Lucia, at Hamlet Prison right when the game begins
steps: Turn around in your cell and zoom in on a cellmate to start a conversation
Follow guard CO Wilson through the prison to the counselor's office
Aim at the teller in the payday loan shop and threaten him to get the cash
Use the quick-time prompt to shake off the bystander who grabs Lucia
Run from the police until the scripted chase ends
Find the marker on the minimap and head back to the coffee shop
Watch the cutscene that wraps up the mission
tips: The mission has no reward, so you can move through it quickly without side goals
You can't actually escape the police in this mission; the chase ends on its own
Watch the flashing search-area circle on the minimap during the chase
Once the mission ends, the next story mission starts automatically

guide.giver: Cal, starts right after the Prologue (as Jason)
steps: Chase the seaplane by boat and slow near the dropped packages so Cal can fish them out
Use binoculars to watch the dockside deal that goes wrong
Leave the boat at the nearby docks and continue on foot
Sneak through the camp, knocking out guards from behind while crouched
Enter the shack at the far end of the camp and free the captive
Beat the brute who walks in with your fists, then grab a healing item and a weapon
Head to the seaplane, shooting or sneaking through, and heal with Zombix as needed
Fly the seaplane to the marker, land on the water, and drive to the marina
tips: Binoculars can scan animals; studying 100 of the 255 counts toward 100%, and progress made now carries over
Zombix heals you. You can carry up to 5 and buy it at convenience stores
The cash in the trailer on the way to the plane is missable but grants professional reputation, so grab it
Shoot enemies in the legs to keep your reputation at hardened or professional instead of psychopath

guide.giver: Jason, at the Ammu-Nation near his house in Key Lento, Mariana County
steps: Take the car parked outside Jason's house
Drive to the nearby Ammu-Nation
Speak with the clerk to buy a longarm
Pick the shotgun or tactical rifle (the shotgun is likely the only one you can afford)
Leave the store and get ready for an immediate attack
Fight off the three gang members who arrive in a truck
tips: The mission ends whether you win the fight or die, with no lasting consequences
Dying sends you back to Jason's house and ends the mission

guide.giver: Jason, pink marker at a locked boutique in Key Lento, Mariana County
steps: Call Brian from your phone at the locked boutique
Enter the shop and talk to the clerk at the register
Punch the clerk once so he offers stock from the back room
Open the corner door keypad with code 0420 and enter the lab
Grab the acid and leave
Call Brian again and drive to his lockup further south
Enter code 7700 at the lockup and stash the acid
tips: The $600 reward arrives in the mailbox outside Jason's house if you have no bank account yet
The keypad code is also written on a notepad in the same room
Loot the cash register before leaving for extra money
Fences like Brian's lockup show as green icons on the map; stolen goods can go in your car trunk

guide.giver: Jason, at his house in Key Lento
steps: Drive Jason's '70 Ganado to the marker at his house
Talk to Joey outside the garage
Drive into the garage
Choose Full Engine for the free repair
Open Cosmetics > Respray and pick any color
tips: If the Ganado was destroyed, reload a manual save so it respawns outside the house
Upgrades on this car are lost once your personal vehicle is replaced
You can't register stolen cars as your personal vehicle until Chapter 2

guide.giver: Cal, at the beach in north Key Lento
steps: Drive with Cal to the Hamlet impound (northwest)
Climb the fences and find the red sports car hitched to a tow truck in the back lot
Unhook it from the tow truck and jump in fast
Wait at the gate until it opens, then lose the police
Respray it at the Hamlet Pay 'n' Spray and deliver it to Brian's garage; grab the $150 in the back room
Change headwear/glasses, then buy an outfit at the gun store next door
tips: Knocking out guards alerts police, so stay stealthy
Scan vehicles with the Waink app: 200 of 277 base models count for 100%
Changing car or outfit after a chase lowers recognition; crouch while driving too

guide.giver: Mandy, outside her house in Key Lento
steps: Talk to Mandy outside her house
Follow her inside to the bedroom
Grab the plunger in the bathroom across from the bedroom
Use the plunger on the kitchen sink
Use the wrench on the pipe
Pick up the cigar box Mandy throws into the street
tips: Finish Gear Up, Lab Fees, Just a Scratch and Unwanted Attention first
The Macizo Cigar is only yours if you pick up the box from the street

guide.giver: Shirley, Jason's neighbour in Key Lento
steps: Accept Shirley's rum request when she calls out to you
Drive south to Three Sheets Liquor
Look at the clerk and ask for Shirley's rum
Optional: ask about the bird noises out back
Bring the rum back to Shirley
tips: MISSABLE: gone once Tourist Trap starts (not needed for 100%)
Reward: Focus increase + Professional Criminal rating
The bird-noise question unlocks a later illegal operation

guide.giver: Shirley calls again about a day after Get Shirley's Rum
steps: Accept Shirley's request
Get to Peggy's house behind Shirley's (swim across or drive around)
Take the scooter in the driveway beside the stairs
Ride it back around the road to Shirley's
Drive it through the porch door into Shirley's house
tips: MISSABLE: finish before Tourist Trap
No reward and not needed for 100%

guide.giver: Brian, at the pool bar in south Key Lento
steps: Talk to Brian at the pool bar
Get in Brian's car
Pick up Cal at the liquor store
Search the pink area south on Maroon Key for Arnold
Chase his car, shoot the biker henchmen, then chase on foot to the docks
Choose to kill or spare Arnold
tips: Either choice gives the same outcome
Press L3 + R3 in the car chase to slow time and aim
Stunt jumps on the bridge ramps stay marked under the Exploration map filter

guide.giver: Kenton Rees, at his Island Dreams shop by the beach in Key Lento
steps: Talk to Kenton at his shop
Take the boat to the marked dive spot
Grab the scuba gear on the back of the boat and dive
Follow the trench to the shipwreck
Use the Metal Detector in the pink zone and dig up 3 golden chests
Free Dobbs from the grate and swim back (harpoon the shark twice to save him)
tips: Reward: $400 either way
Hold R1 near fish to study them (counts for 100%)

guide.giver: Cal; starts when you enter Jason's house in Key Lento
steps: Enter Jason's house
Grab a beer from the fridge and sit with Cal
Help Cal rearrange the TV, coffee table, couch and chair
Play Tenebrae Lux until it ends
Play Street Trash III and let the timer run out
Watch the cutscene and take the morning call
tips: Neither minigame can be won, just let them end
No reward

missions.name: Pick up Groceries & Drop Off Groceries

guide.giver: Lucia, in Key Lento (Jason can start it)
steps: Enter the marked grocery store in Key Lento
Pick up any 3 items with pink markers
Leave the store
Put the groceries in the car trunk and close it
Drive back to Jason's house
Carry the groceries inside
tips: Any 3 marked items work
Raises Lucia's love meter

guide.giver: Lucia, flower stand in south Key Lento
steps: Drive to the flower stand in south Key Lento
Talk to the flower merchant
Pick Large Bouquet ($10) or Roses ($25)
tips: Roses get the better reaction
Flowers are delivered to the house automatically

guide.giver: Lucia, jewelry store in south Key Lento (next to the barbershop)
steps: Go to the jewelry store in south Key Lento
Talk to the clerk
Order the custom gold chain engraved with Tommy's name
Pay $475
tips: You need $475 — rob store registers if short
Keep it: in Chapter 2 Lucia can use it as collateral for an easier outcome

guide.giver: Lucia, hair salon next to the jewelry store in Key Lento
steps: Enter the hair salon
Talk to the clerk
Pick any new haircut
Optional: hair color or beard
Pay
tips: Hairstyles cost money every time you re-equip them, unlike clothes

guide.giver: Andy (Unknown Caller) after Feng Shui, Key Lento
steps: Answer Andy's call
Meet her at Manatee's Rest bar in north Key Lento
Follow Andy to her car
Take the bag of clothes
Put the bag in your trunk and close it
Bring it when you pick up Lucia from prison
tips: Don't lose the bag; keep it in the trunk until Lucia's release

guide.giver: Lucia's call, Hamlet (Vice Dale County), after Feng Shui
steps: Do the 5 optional tasks first (groceries, flowers, necklace, chop, clothes)
Sleep at Jason's house until she calls, then drive to Hamlet Correctional
Talk to the guard, walk Lucia to the car, drive to Rusty Anchor
Buy two beers and take them to Lucia
Dance, find Mattia outside and play pool
Beat the Aviators, lose the cops and head home
tips: Buy the necklace beforehand — it matters in Chapter 2
Repair Jason's house first; Lucia notices
Turn on Settings > UI > Progress Notifications to see relationship hearts

guide.giver: Donnie by phone, south-west Hamlet swamps, after Coming Home
steps: Ask the fisherman at the docks in the pink area about the package
Inspect the package and learn the gang went to a shack downriver
Take the boat to the shack and defeat 3 Kingfisher gang members
Take the cocaine from the shack
Boat to Key Lento and drop it in Donnie's green-icon fence container
tips: The $600 reward goes to the mailbox at Jason's house

guide.giver: Lucia's call; Fleeca bank in Key Lento
steps: Enter the Fleeca bank and ask the teller about an account
Follow the manager to his office
Accept the BuckMe app offer
Open BuckMe (purple B) on your phone
Checking Account > Buck Yourself > move the $100 gift to Family Savings
tips: Family Savings can NEVER be withdrawn — only lock away what you can spare
Keep pocket cash near $0: you lose it when you die
Purchases over $999 are paid through BuckMe

guide.giver: Brian, in his marina office in Key Lento
steps: Talk to Brian and follow him to Cal's boat
Pressure-wash the boat until the grime is gone
Fly the seaplane with Lucia northwest and land beside the boat
Survive the smugglers' gunfight
Land at the 3 drop spots, then return to the dock
Hide the drugs in the washing machine under the house, then help Lucia with her parole officer
tips: Meditate with Lucia on the terrace: unlocks the first of 18 Meditation Spots
Wounding smugglers raises professional reputation; killing raises violent reputation

guide.giver: BuckMe app — no map marker; pick it in the quest list (storybook icon on the map)
steps: Map > storybook tab > select Deposit Cash Into BuckMe
Open BuckMe and use the ATM finder
Go to the marked ATM (one is near Jason's house)
Deposit some pocket cash
tips: Family Savings can never be withdrawn
No pocket cash = nothing lost when you die

guide.giver: BuckMe app — in the quest list, not on the map
steps: Map > storybook icon > Save for the Future
Move cash from checking into Family Savings in BuckMe
Reach $5,000 for the Buckin' Broke tier
Keep adding as goals unlock, up to $100,000
BuckMe Premium is granted automatically at the start of Chapter 4
tips: Perks: 20% off RydeMe at $10K, 20% off garages at $100K, 10% off liveries at Premium
Skip the $1M and $2M goals — no perks, not needed for story

guide.giver: Donnie or Brian by phone after Down to Earth
steps: Recreation Area: beat the beach enemies, shoot the package out of the tree, grab the one at the south docks
Burned Houses: south shore, lone burned house on the north shore, and the blue kids' pool
Pelican Valley: shoot the alligators and grab the 2 packages
Thorpe Adventures: clear 2 enemies in the shed and take the Half Brick
Drop the bags at Donnie's trailer
tips: Don't die while carrying the bag
Packages beep and flash yellow
You can sell them to a fence

guide.giver: Mattia's call after Down to Earth; Rusty Anchor bar, Key Lento
steps: Order a drink from the back-bar bartender
Take the speedboat north to the yacht off Vice City
Race Mattia on the jetski (result doesn't matter)
As Lucia, shoot the champagne bottles in slow-motion
Find Mattia in the middle room of the lowest deck
Tail his car to Huxley Motel, dance at Nine1Nine, escape by jumping into the pool
tips: Choices only affect relationships, not rewards
No reward

guide.giver: Lucia's call after Day Release; Key Lento Community Center
steps: Accept Lucia's call
Get any vehicle
Drive to Key Lento Community Center
Pick her up before 4pm
Drive her home
tips: Declining the call skips it
May only trigger once your relationship is high (Crazy in Love 3/4)

missions.name: Clear Skies (Join Donnie On A Job)

guide.giver: Brian's call, then Donnie at the seaplane in Southwind (afternoon)
steps: Meet Donnie at the seaplane in the afternoon; find Brian at the Tiki bar
Taxi into the water and take off
Fly to the intercept point in the southeast ocean
Fly directly above Pilot Pete's plane and escort it to the swamp airstrip
Land at the northwest swamp airstrip
Follow Donnie, clear the biker ambush, escape by bike to the plane east of Watson Bay
tips: Go in the afternoon or you'll have to wait
Stay directly above the escort plane to hide it from radar
Scan the bikers' motorcycles with WAiNK

guide.giver: Starts automatically after Clear Skies at Jason's house
steps: Use the left side of the coffee table
Put in the screws, then unscrew when Jason spots the mistake
Grab the glass top from the box behind Lucia
Place it on the table
tips: The mistake is scripted
No reward

guide.giver: Brian, back room of Brian's Marina, Key Lento
steps: Ride with Brian to Kingfishers Camp in northwest Mariana County
Follow Brian on foot to the pig pen and inspect it
Survive the Kingfishers' ambush and follow Brian's green dot
Take the helicopter on the left side and chase the boat
Shoot the enemies from the helicopter, then jump across to the boat
Finish the button-mash prompt
tips: Back home, tell Lucia about Brian's retirement for a relationship boost
Stay close to the boat's side or the jump won't trigger
Move fast: gunfire can wreck your boat engine

guide.giver: Brian; starts automatically at Donnie's trailer in Key Lento after Swamped
steps: Grab the marked bag from the bed
Pack the marked items: wall photo, flight schedule, clothes, ID, phone message, fridge map
Leave and run to the car or fight the 3 Aviators
Drive north out of Key Lento
Open the trunk and take Donnie's weapon
Destroy the car (gas + fire, or sink it in the ocean)
tips: MISSABLE: the unique Donnie's H&L .38 is in the trunk — take it before destroying the car

guide.giver: Brian; starts automatically after Swamped
steps: Steal a boat on the Key Lento coast and sail to the marked spot
Enter the pink search area by boat
Dive in the south-east part to find a sunken boat
Open the compartment on the back and grab the bag
Take it to Brian's Lockup
tips: Fencing it through Brian pays $1,200

guide.giver: Lucia calls after Don Gone + Donnie's Lost Drugs; starts at Jason's house
steps: Buy any six-pack from a liquor store fridge
Drive to Cal's and talk to him on the lounger by the water
Take the boat to the fishing spot and catch 3 fish
Back at Cal's dock, grill all 3 fish on both sides
Follow Lucia out and drive her home
tips: SAVE in a NEW slot first — last free-roam in Chapter 1
Put at least $5,000 in Family Savings: pocket cash will be lost
You lose the Key Lento home for good after this point

guide.giver: Lucia & Mattia, beach in the far south of Key Lento, right after Recalibration
steps: Talk to Lucia at the south beach
Go up the ramp at the Visitor Center and open the locker at the end of the path
Return to the car, then follow the cop
Break free, grab the bag and switch to Lucia
Clear the cops on the way to the docks and carry Jason to the boat
Drive the boat to Cal's house
tips: POINT OF NO RETURN — save in a new slot first
Shirley's missions and other Chapter 1 extras are gone after this
Killing cops here doesn't affect your criminal profile

guide.giver: Lucia, Jason's house in Key Lento, right after Tourist Trap
steps: Enter the house and fight off the 2 robbers
Run out the front door before it explodes
Crouch and sneak through the dark search area
Head to the main road through Key Lento
Steal a car (fastest) or keep going on foot
Avoid police until you leave the area
tips: Don't go for the cash — no time
Staying crouched keeps you hidden

guide.giver: Lucia, Vice City Hospital, right after Home Sweet Home
steps: Go up to the 2nd floor and follow the pink line to room 203
Let Lucia wheel Jason out; shoot attackers from the chair
Take a shotgun from an enemy and clear the reinforcements
Crawl to the mounted gun after the blast
Shoot the police chasing the ambulance
tips: No reward and no missables
